blocks.text: Youville is a residential treatment for alcohol or drug addicts. It is a long term drug and alcohol rehab which could even extend up to three years if that is necessary. It is for women only and consists of three phases. The first one is called “New Beginning”, the second is called “New Direction” and the final phase is called “Family Reunification”. There is also a part of the program which can include the mothers and their children in a more independent living environment. The program is composed mainly of counselling, whether it is individual or in group. There is also a day treatment that is outpatient.
